As the ocean's waves crashed onto the shore,
A symphony of sound, a dance of the tide;
The sand, a canvas, waiting to be told,
A story of the sea, in patterns bold.

The waves swept up, a swirling vortex,
A whirlpool of water, a maelstrom of might;
The sand, a treasure trove, of shells and of stones,
A hidden world, revealed in the ocean's throne.

When the waves pulled back, a poem was born,
A lyrical language, of the sea's sweet scorn;
The patterns, a tapestry, of waves and of sand,
A narrative of the ocean's, mysterious hand.

The poem spoke of the sea's, eternal power,
A force that shapes, and molds, and draws each hour;
Of the tides that rise, and the tides that fall,
A rhythm that echoes, through it all.

The poem whispered secrets, of the deep blue sea,
A language of the waves, that only the ocean can see;
Of the creatures that dwell, in the dark and the cold,
A world of wonder, that's yet to be told.

The poem asked questions, of the universe's might,
A query of the cosmos, in the dark of night;
What lies beyond, the horizon's frame;
What secrets hide, in the ocean's endless claim?

The poem searched for answers, in the waves' gentle sway,
A quest for meaning, in the ocean's endless way;
But the answers, like the waves, remain elusive and free,
A mystery that's hidden, in the ocean's wild sea.

The poem stood tall, a testament to the sea's roar,
A declaration of the ocean's, eternal score;
A symphony of sound, that echoes through the years,
A poem of the ocean, that brings us to tears.
